title: Meta Plans New Stock Class to Fund AI Investments
excerpt: Social media giant Meta is developing a new stock strategy to finance its extensive artificial intelligence model and service buildout.
body_html:
Social media corporation Meta is preparing a new stock strategy designed to support its wide-ranging investments in artificial intelligence models and services.

According to recent plans, the company intends to use this newly created class of stock to help pay for its broad AI infrastructure buildout. The financial approach is aimed at powering the firm's ongoing development within the artificial intelligence sector.
